appetiteScore.title: Appetite Score
appetiteScore.description: The underwriting appetite score (0–100). Lower means weaker appetite alignment.

message.title: Message
message.description: Result summary stating the risk score, appetite score and review priority on success, or the error detail if it failed.

reviewPriority.title: Review Priority
reviewPriority.description: The recommended review priority — e.g. High Priority, Standard Review, or Low Priority.

riskScore.title: Risk Score
riskScore.description: The submission's overall risk score (0–100). Higher means greater assessed risk.

success.title: Success
success.description: True if the risk evaluation completed and the submission was updated; false if it failed.
